description: Official Antigravity CLI (agy) print-mode output. Each fixture is antigravity-<name>.stdout plus antigravity-<name>.exit (the process exit status). Stderr is never kept. origin: live = printed by agy as-is; derived = a live capture with the named fields edited; synthetic = not observed.

fixtures.name: usage-live
fixtures.description: A signed-in account: two groups, four buckets (gemini-weekly 0.9946, gemini-5h 0.9894, 3p-weekly 1, 3p-5h 1), num_turns 0, every token count 0. Contains no email, token or account identifier.

fixtures.name: credits-live
fixtures.description: The same account: remaining_credits 0, num_turns 0, every token count 0.

fixtures.name: usage-signed-out
fixtures.description: Not a fixture capture. Modelled on the one probe with an empty CLI home on 2026-11-16, where agy did not answer and instead started an interactive Google sign-in: it printed a sign-in URL on stderr, waited for authentication (timeout 60s) and opened the sign-in page in the browser. That run was ended after about 15 s without signing in. The stdout here has the shape it printed on the way out; the exit status 1 is a stand-in, since none was observed.
